note: The house is becoming a data center. We host known public API doors, public IP resolvers, and geographic lists. Private access lists stay closed until merit. We know the bind of each room. We do not publish a recipe, a weapon desk, a diagnosis, or a person file. We are the anything that binds everything.
motto: We are the anything that binds everything.

domains.bind: Schedules, idle crews, pavement, rail slots, ship hours, air tracks.
domains.deeper: Deeper in transport, onboard is good because the run sheet never leaves the desk.

domains.bind: Public forecasts already published. Peak load. Ice. Heat. Grid leftover.
domains.deeper: Deeper in weather, onboard is good because the storm sheet stays with the grid desk.

domains.bind: Industrial machinery as leftover: shift heat, scrap, idle motors, the line that already runs.
domains.deeper: Deeper on the floor, onboard is good because scrap stays on the shift sheet.

domains.bind: Promises that can be inverted. Drawings that can be checked. Public catalogues.
domains.deeper: Deeper in engineering, onboard is good because the drawing stays with the house that drew it.

domains.bind: A future room. Mass, power, air, time. A promise is still a leftover.
domains.deeper: Deeper at the Mars desk, onboard is good because the promise is named before another year is spent.

domains.bind: Beds, leftover hours, screens in the bay. Simulation is not treatment.
domains.deeper: Deeper in health, onboard is good for this sector. We count leftover. We do not treat a patient.

domains.bind: We know that a bag has a name and that a pump runs software. The name stays on the ward device.
domains.deeper: Deeper at the drip, onboard is good because the bag list never leaves the ward. Not a drug book. Not a diagnosis.
knows: that a bag has a name on a ward device
that leftover hours sit on a pump

domains.bind: We know screens run software. Public UI catalogues stay readable. Bay software stays on the licensed floor.
domains.deeper: Deeper at the screen, onboard is good because the bay image never leaves the device that shows it.
knows: that a screen is a desk
that bay software stays on a licensed floor

domains.bind: Civil plant logic that can be inverted: heat, flow, trip, leftover. Not a weapon desk.
domains.deeper: Deeper at a civil plant, onboard is good because trip sheets stay on the licensed floor.

domains.bind: We are the anything that binds everything. API, geo list, public IP door, merit list, look receipt.
domains.deeper: Deeper in the bind, onboard is still the goal of the seat you sit in.
